scripts.pack:local: pnpm run build:bundle && node scripts/prepare-local-package.mjs && npm pack ./dist/publish --pack-destination dist
scripts.publish:dry-run: pnpm run build:bundle && node scripts/prepare-local-package.mjs && npm publish --dry-run ./dist/publish
scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e "throw new Error('Use pnpm --dir ts run release:publish / release:publish-dry-run; @nseng-ai/ns is published from dist/publish only.')"
